# Fish 'N Chicks & Nauti Buoys Charters Key West (concept by Kerblabs)

> Private boat charters out of Key West, FL on a 25ft Robalo Cayman (300 HP) with founder Captain Raquel Crummitt. Facts from fishnchickskeywest.com. Prices are not published there.

## Trips
- Sunset cruises
- Dolphin watching
- Sandbar tours
- Snorkeling
- Scatter ashes at sea

## Contact
- Phone: (904) 994-5824
- Email: fishnchickscharters@gmail.com
- Listed address: 5710 Overseas Highway, Key West, FL 33040
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fishnchickscharterskey

## Actions
- Book online via FareHarbor from https://fishnchickskeywest.com
- Call or email the captain to confirm trip and price

## FAQ
- What boat? A 25ft Robalo Cayman, 300 HP.
- Cost? Not published on the current site; confirm with the captain.
